exposure: Perceived size of child at birth
Children having had diarrhea in last two weeks
cohort: The study included 6,965 children under-five (0-59 months) from Bangladesh.
finding: The prevalence of stunting was 36.5% for children aged 0-59 months and 40.2% for children aged 0-23 months, with multiple maternal, child, and socioeconomic factors significantly associated with stunting.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as a significant factor for stunting in both children aged 0-59 months and 0-23 months.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey 2014.
birth_weight: Perceived size of child at birth was measured.
